goal: Add a multi-floor roguelike run structure layered on top of Pet Snake's classic gameplay.

floorFlow: Initialize floor config (board size, difficulty, mode variant)
Play until goal met or hearts depleted
On success: freeze board, show summary, present upgrades and route choices
On failure: end run and show Adventure summary

floorParameters.vacuum: optional per floor; boss floor guaranteed

goals.description: Outlast the vacuum with altered spawn tables

floorAffixes.effect: Treats spawn only near center lanes; edges sparsely populated
Base tick +15-25%; each treat grants +1 score
Treats give half score, half coins toward meta shop
Vacuum turn chance increased, tail decay faster
Bomb spawn chance doubled; explosions always cut snake length in half
Only a radius around the snake is fully lit; rest dimmed
Treat spawn timer longer but base score +2

collars.name: Safety Collar
collars.effect: +1 max heart; first wall/self hit only removes 1 heart

collars.name: Zoomie Collar
collars.effect: Permanent -10% tick; +1 score when eating during speed powerup

collars.name: Therapy Collar
collars.effect: Heal 1 heart every N treats if below max

toys.name: Vacuum Toy
toys.effect: Vacuum steals may spawn random powerups elsewhere

toys.name: Bomb Plushie
toys.effect: Bomb explosions cut 1/3 length; shield converts bombs to +3 score

toys.name: Feather Wand
toys.effect: One ghost-step through your body per floor

treatPerks.name: Snack Streaks
treatPerks.effect: Combo multiplier when eating treats without collisions

treatPerks.name: Treat Magnet
treatPerks.effect: Treats spawn closer to head via Manhattan bias

routeChoices.ui: After each floor, show 2-3 buttons describing the next room (board size, hazards, rewards)
routeChoices.data: Each node defines boardChoice, difficultyDelta, affixes, vacuum flag

heartsAndFailure.ui: Show hearts in meters panel alongside powerup timers
heartsAndFailure.healing: Treats, upgrades, and special events can restore or increase hearts

metaProgression.storage: Use localStorage to track total coins, runs won, unlock flags
unlocks: New pets (e.g., Bunny after 5 Adventure wins)
New affixes/powerups added to the pool
metaProgression.summaryScreen: After each run, report floors cleared, score, treats, coins earned

phases: Phase 2: leaves dust piles acting as bombs
Phase 3: faster vacuum, shorter tail decay
counterUpgrades: Cord Chewer (once per run shrink tail on hit)

features: 15-floor script: forage, survive, and boss floors with scripted progression
Expanded affix pool with speed, scoring, spawn, and meta modifiers
6 upgrade cards (2 collars, 2 toys, 2 treat perks)
